families.label: Banking and Lending Operations
families.definition: Provision and administration of depository, transaction, commercial, consumer, mortgage, and specialty finance products and services.

capabilities.label: Commercial banking
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to provide regulated deposit, credit, treasury, transaction, and related banking services to businesses and institutions.

capabilities.label: Consumer banking
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to provide regulated deposit, payment, credit, and account services to individual consumers through branch or digital channels.

capabilities.label: Deposit account services
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to open, maintain, safeguard, transact against, and service regulated demand, savings, time, or custodial deposit accounts.

capabilities.label: Consumer lending
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to originate, underwrite, fund, and service personal, education, vehicle, revolving, or other consumer credit products.

capabilities.label: Mortgage lending and servicing
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to originate, acquire, underwrite, fund, administer, or service residential or commercial mortgage obligations.

capabilities.label: Specialty finance
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to provide non-depository or specialized credit, receivables, structured finance, consumer finance, or asset-backed financing products.

families.label: Insurance Underwriting and Administration
families.definition: Assumption, pricing, pooling, transfer, and administration of insured risk through regulated insurance and reinsurance products.

capabilities.label: Property and casualty insurance underwriting
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to price, assume, pool, and administer property, liability, casualty, or related insured risks under regulated insurance contracts.

capabilities.label: Life and health insurance underwriting
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to price, assume, pool, and administer mortality, longevity, disability, health, or related insured risks under regulated contracts.

capabilities.label: Reinsurance
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to assume, transfer, price, and administer portions of risks originally underwritten by insurance carriers.

capabilities.label: Insurance policy administration
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to issue, maintain, bill, renew, endorse, and service insurance policies throughout their contractual lifecycle.

capabilities.label: Insurance claims administration
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to receive, investigate, adjudicate, reserve, settle, and report insurance claims on behalf of a risk-bearing or administrative entity.

families.label: Securities and Investment Services
families.definition: Origination, execution, distribution, management, and advisory activities involving securities, investments, capital markets, and managed assets.

capabilities.label: Securities brokerage
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to receive, route, execute, clear, custody, or service customer transactions in regulated securities and investment products.

capabilities.label: Investment banking
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to advise on and execute capital raising, securities issuance, mergers, acquisitions, restructurings, or related capital-market transactions.

capabilities.label: Asset management
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to manage investment portfolios, mandates, funds, or pooled assets under defined strategies, fiduciary duties, and risk controls.

capabilities.label: Wealth management
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to integrate investment, planning, trust, tax-aware, estate, and financial services for individuals, families, or private clients.

capabilities.label: Securities trading and market making
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to trade securities for customers or own account, quote two-sided markets, provide liquidity, or manage associated market risk.

families.label: Financial Infrastructure and Data
families.definition: Operation of financial transaction networks, specialized data services, credit and risk information products, and leased-asset finance infrastructure.

capabilities.label: Payment network operation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate networks, rules, routing, authorization, clearing, settlement, or risk controls that enable electronic payments.

capabilities.label: Financial data services
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to collect, normalize, govern, analyze, and deliver financial, market, transaction, pricing, or reference data as a product or service.

capabilities.label: Credit and risk information services
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to develop and deliver credit, identity, fraud, actuarial, underwriting, or risk information used in financial decisions.

capabilities.label: Equipment leasing and asset finance
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to acquire, finance, lease, administer, and remarket equipment or other productive assets under commercial agreements.
